opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call.
opportunities.summary: Supports ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences.

opportunities.opportunity_id: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Seed funding will be made available for which participants can apply.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible applicants must be early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Brings together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to discuss key questions around the theme of 'Humans and nature: More resilient towards the future'.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The Fellowship is tenable for three years, starting from Autumn 2027 in a UK-based university or higher education institution.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible applicants must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences and be based at an eligible university or research organisation for the duration of the Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: A three-year award made to an annual cohort of outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible Lead Applicants must be ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom and be holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution (HEI) or Independent Research Organisation (IRO).
opportunities.summary: Promotes the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: The total funding available per award in this call is up to £300,000 over 2 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The Principal Investigator (PI) must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences and be based at an eligible UK university or research institute and hold an established role that will last at least the duration of their prospective award.
opportunities.summary: Supports projects which engage with questions concerning the relationship between expertise, public understanding and policy delivery internationally.

opportunities.opportunity_id: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: The Academy is offering up to two one-year fellowships hosted in DGAP's offices in Berlin. These are offered as awards for up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications are invited in any of the following areas: Security, Defence, and Resilience in a New Threat Environment, Indo-European Relations, Technology and AI, Strategy-Making in Europe.
opportunities.summary: Provides opportunities to UK-based early and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences to develop their skills, networks and careers in the creative and cultural, public, private and policy sectors.
